en: The postcard front shows a black-and-white photograph of a large institutional building labeled 'Sköns Fattiggård', surrounded by open fields and trees, with a flag on a central pole. There is handwritten Swedish text at the bottom. The reverse side includes handwritten addresses and a green Swedish postage stamp, suggesting use around the early 1900s. The card is printed in Swedish, with pre-printed address fields and published by Wahlberg & Kabner, Lund.
